display.title: The Fiefdom of Bad Neighbors
display.tagline: Good fences make good neighbors. Castles make better ones.

theme.premise: Season I explores European conflicts and rivalries relevant to Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition.

brief: Europe has never been particularly good at minding its own business.
Across the continent, kingdoms, republics, empires and ambitious lords fight over borders, crowns, trade routes, faith and old grievances.

Throughout Season I, the league will revisit conflicts and regions drawn from the world of Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition. Alliances will shift. Armies will cross borders. Neighbors will become enemies.
And when the dust settles, somebody will inevitably hold a grudge.
story.homepageTeaser: The gates are open. Season I takes the league across the wars, rivalries and contested frontiers of Europe. Enter the season, raise your banner, and prepare to meet some very bad neighbors.
story.oneLine: A season of European wars, shifting alliances and very bad neighbors.

launchNews.heading: SEASON I: THE FIEFDOM OF BAD NEIGHBORS
body: What begins here is more than a series of matches. Victories will be remembered. Defeats will leave scars. Alliances will form, grudges will grow, and every battle will become part of the history of the league.
Across the coming season, commanders will face one another in conflicts inspired by the battlefields, rivalries and regions of medieval Europe.
No two events will be alike. But every one of them will count.
